ALTER VIEW [DW].[DimCustomerNameTest_CBG_View] AS
Select DC.* from DW.DimCustomerNameTest DC
    WHERE DC.CustomerID IN(Select Distinct CustomerID from DW.DimCustomer DC
    WHERE DC.BankSK = 1
    AND DC.CustomerSK IN(
        Select distinct CustomerSK from dw.dimcustomeraccount cbg
        WHERE (cbg.sourcesystemcode = 'CCD'
                OR cbg.sourcesystemcode = 'LNS')
        AND cbg.banksk = 1
        AND cbg.currentindicator = 1))
